scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed an efficient, methodical analysis. It started with an overview, identified the dominant pattern (161/170 errors on net472), drilled into specific error codes, verified the project configuration (multi-targeting without conditions), and produced a clear, well-structured root cause analysis with actionable fixes. The approach was systematic — overview → error categorization → pattern recognition → verification → synthesis. The agent recovered gracefully when source files weren't available in the binlog and used alternative approaches. The final output is comprehensive, accurate, and actionable.
scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem
